sources.title: Model API | Muse Glimmer - dev.meta.ai
sources.snippet: Model variants ... Architecture Muse Glimmer is a dense, decoder-only multimodal transformer with a built-in vision encoder. It is trained from Muse Spark's outputs rather than training from scratch. It accepts text and image input, produces text output, and has a default context window of 128K tokens with support for longer contexts.

sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.
